item.title: Preliminary Notice on Error Popups After the 7/9 Scheduled Update
item.description:
Hello, this is Project Moon.

Following the Scheduled Update on Jul. 9th, we have confirmed an issue in which error messages appear during gameplay due to higher-than-expected server load.

We are currently investigating the issue and will provide a follow-up notice once we have identified the exact cause.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.
